free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'After the expiration period, the account returns to free mode' - free mode carries no transfer, and the only plans are paid: Test 24h, Pro and Lite.
free_tier.notes: The host list marks individual hosts 'Free' or 'Pro'; that is a host class, not a plan. Free mode's actual allowance is not published.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: links only, no storage

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage product; the pricing page says account expiry 'does not delete data or history'

egress.terms: 'I do not limit speed - you will reach the maximum of your connection. Our servers in the EU have a total capacity of 120 Gbps.' Transfer is capped per day instead: 35 GB/day on both paid plans.

record.interface_detail: JDownloader 2, pyLoad and IDM plugins documented on the pricing FAQ; web downloader otherwise.
record.tooling: JDownloader 2, pyLoad, IDM. No API documented publicly.
record.chaining: 35 GB/day is 1.05 TB/month, enough for the 1 TiB monthly volume, but at PLN 29.99 (USD 7.69) it is above the debrid USD 5 bar and adds a Polish-currency payment step.

limits.value: 35 GB/day on Pro and Lite; 35 GB total on the 24-hour test
none published; the FAQ says a link is checked before quota is spent

record.limits_note: Lite covers 122 of 161 hosts and excludes 'Pro hosts' entirely; Pro covers all 161. Only Lite and Pro differ in host coverage, not in daily transfer.
record.binding_note: 35 GB/day is 1.05 TB/month, which just clears 1 TiB, so the daily counter is what binds; on Lite the tighter constraint is the 39 missing hosts, not the bytes.

identity_cost.detail: Checkout in PLN by card, wire or crypto ('Global · Wire · Card · Crypto'). Account creation details were not readable without an order flow.

record.reliability_note: Hosts carry a 'Maintenance' state in the on-page list; quota is shared across every device on the account, so parallel downloads spend the same 35 GB/day.
record.confidence_note: Prices and transfer quotas are quoted from the vendor's pricing page. The free-mode allowance and the account fields are unverified.

evidence.proved: 'Test 24h 9.99 PLN - Transfer: 35 GB - Hosts: 161'; 'Pro 39.99 PLN / mo - Transfer: 35 GB / day - Hosts: 161'; 'Lite 29.99 PLN / mo - Transfer: 35 GB / day - Hosts: 122 of 161'; 'No. Every plan is a one-time payment. After the expiration period, the account returns to free mode'
'Active services 154', 'Files 115 hosts', and per-host counters such as 'Copycase 0.00 / 35 GB' showing the daily counter shape

record.price_per_tb_month: PLN 29.99/month Lite, PLN 39.99/month Pro (USD 7.69 and USD 10.26 at 3.899348 PLN/USD on 2026-10-23)
record.notes: A Polish service with PLN-only pricing, which is why it does not surface in English comparisons. It clears 100 GiB/month on paper (35 GB/day) but misses the USD 5 bar. Currency conversion from the exchangerate-api USD base read on 2026-10-23.
